report:
Dura, left parafalcine tumour, craniotomy and excision

Two smear preparations are made from the tissue. They show cohesive cellular clusters of ovoid to short spindle cells with scant cytoplasm, with scattered single cells and wisps of collagenous stroma. Sections show a cellular neoplasm in which densely packed, monotonous ovoid to round cells with indistinct cell borders and little intervening stroma are arranged around prominent thin-walled, branching staghorn vessels. Mitoses number 7 per 10 high-power fields. No necrosis is identified. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells show strong diffuse nuclear STAT6 expression. They are negative for EMA, SSTR2A and S100, with patchy weak staining for CD34. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 8 per cent.

DURA, left, craniotomy and excision - SOLITARY FIBROUS TUMOUR, CNS WHO grade 2
- Histological appearance: cellular neoplasm with staghorn vessels
- Immunohistochemistry: STAT6 strong diffuse nuclear; CD34 patchy and weak; EMA negative; SSTR2A negative; S100 negative
- CNS WHO grade 2
